versions.changelog:
Initial release of gemini-web-automation-skill.

- Provides automation to interact with Gemini Web via scripts for sending prompts, continuing conversations, and file/image uploads.
- All daily operations are routed through `scripts/chat.py`, which manages environment, session, login, and returns structured JSON.
- Error handling and recovery are standardized; agents don't interact with the browser directly.
- Login recovery and page structure maintenance are supported via dedicated scripts (`bootstrap.py`, `analyze_page.py`).
- Emphasizes minimal user disruption: Chrome runs minimized by default unless specified otherwise.
